title: Korean beauty recommendation rules
status: MVP design specification, not an implemented or clinically validated engine

questionnaire_mapping.question: kit_scope
questionnaire_mapping.effect: Select category slots; help_choose requires a visible, editable proposed slot list.

questionnaire_mapping.question: budget
questionnaire_mapping.effect: Limit the whole new-purchase kit, not each product; normalize to integer cents. No inferred budget.

questionnaire_mapping.question: shopping_country
questionnaire_mapping.effect: Use the matching market and exact regional formula. Catalog currently covers United States only.

questionnaire_mapping.question: owned_and_keep
questionnaire_mapping.effect: Fill only slots explicitly kept by the user with zero new spend; count retained items toward routine complexity; do not claim tolerance or compatibility from ownership alone.

questionnaire_mapping.question: goals
questionnaire_mapping.effect: Choose at most two ordered, distinct goals. Score only relevant slots; deduplicate confirmed photo observations.

questionnaire_mapping.question: routine_time
questionnaire_mapping.effect: Suggest editable daily-item caps of 3, 5, 7, 3 respectively. These are editorial complexity defaults, not predicted application times.

questionnaire_mapping.question: reactions_and_avoid
questionnaire_mapping.effect: Known ingredient exclusions are hard constraints. A previous bad reaction excludes that exact product. Unspecified reaction history prompts details; sensitivity alone does not prove any product is safe.

questionnaire_mapping.question: daily_skin_feel
questionnaire_mapping.effect: Use self-reported feel for skincare fit; no photo override.

questionnaire_mapping.question: coverage
questionnaire_mapping.effect: Determine requested base/concealer format and coverage; never infer desired coverage from visible spots.

questionnaire_mapping.question: makeup_skill
questionnaire_mapping.effect: Score application demands against verified usage instructions. Missing product instructions receive no ease credit.

questionnaire_mapping.question: texture_and_requirements
questionnaire_mapping.effect: Record lightweight/rich/nonsticky as soft preferences. Ask whether fragrance-free or vegan is mandatory or preferred; mandatory requirements filter, preferences rank.

questionnaire_mapping.question: makeup_followups
questionnaire_mapping.effect: When needed, ask finish, lip/cheek color family, eye effect, wear/removal preference, and a known well-fitting foundation brand/product/shade. Shade numbers are never mapped across brands by number alone.

selfie_policy.quality_gate: If blur, strong color cast, occlusion, filters, or makeup prevent usable color observation, abstain; offer optional retake or questionnaire fallback. Thresholds must be validated for each extractor, not invented here.
selfie_policy.confirmation_gate: Unconfirmed observations contribute zero. Confirmed cosmetic observations become editable profile inputs, never a diagnosis. A confirmed approximate tone narrows a shade shortlist but does not establish an exact shade match.
selfie_policy.conflict_rule: Retain explicit reported skin feel and selected cosmetic preferences; show disagreement and offer correction. A photo UI can invite the user to select a cosmetic goal, but may not derive hydration from pixels. Deduplicate the same user-selected goal supplied through multiple UI steps.
selfie_policy.confidence_rule: No numerical probability without calibration. Separate observation quality, user confirmation, product evidence coverage, and shade-match status. Confirmation alone does not validate the photo model.

filter_aggregation: Run only applicable filters. A non-applicable filter is skipped; an applicable known satisfied check passes. Any failed hard check excludes. With no failures but unresolved applicable evidence, return needs_verification. Otherwise eligible. Only eligible candidates fulfill selected slots; pending options may be previewed separately. Stock and checkout-cost verification remain additional purchase-ready gates.

filter_applicability.F01: All candidates; shade is applicable only to a shaded SKU.
filter_applicability.F02: Only when a user has ingredient exclusions or a prior reaction to this exact product; an empty avoidance/reaction list passes.
filter_applicability.F03: Only mandatory declared requirements; an empty requirement list passes.
filter_applicability.F04: Every new purchase, plus whole-kit check; owned retained items have zero new spend.
filter_applicability.F05: Only requested base/concealer slots; all other slots skip.
filter_applicability.F07: Only candidates with a verified product-specific removal dependency or an unresolved applicable removal need.

hard_filters.check: Exact purchasable product version, market, size, shade, product ID
hard_filters.notes: Variant identity and price evidence must align. Complete shade-specific INCI verification is a separate F02/F03 requirement when applicable; a general product ingredient list does not prove shade-specific absence.

hard_filters.check: Explicit ingredient avoidance and prior product reactions
hard_filters.notes: Presence in any verified ingredients/evidence can exclude. Absence requires a complete current formula and reviewed ingredient-name aliases; key ingredients cannot clear this filter. Passing does not guarantee personal tolerance.

hard_filters.check: Mandatory fragrance-free, vegan, or other declared requirement
hard_filters.notes: Use verified exact-variant evidence. Omission from key ingredients is not proof.

hard_filters.check: Known price and requested spending cap
hard_filters.notes: Individual affordability is necessary but insufficient; enforce whole-kit cost later.
A shortlisted approximate shade may be previewed but remains pending until the user chooses a supported exact shade. No current catalog base-makeup SKU exists.

hard_filters.check: Daytime sunscreen slot has verified broad-spectrum SPF at least 30 in the chosen market
hard_filters.notes: A cushion SPF claim does not automatically fill the sunscreen slot.

hard_filters.check: Requested makeup removal needs are met
hard_filters.notes: If verified product instructions require a compatible remover, retain an owned remover or add one within budget and item cap; otherwise defer that makeup choice.

scoring.purpose: Explainable editorial fit within a slot; not an efficacy, medical safety, or probability score.
scoring.acceptable_alternative_rule: No 0.5 awards until a slot-specific fallback mapping is explicitly authored and versioned.
scoring.dimension_activation: Skin feel activates from a known daily_skin_feel answer; goals activate only from distinct relevant user goals; texture/finish/color/coverage/wear/format activate from explicit preferences. Application simplicity activates for quick_easy or an explicit simple-application preference; makeup_skill new or basics may also activate it for makeup. routine_time alone sets the item cap and does not assert application ease.
scoring.simplicity_match: For a user wanting simple application, award 1 only if reviewed instructions establish one application operation without a separate tool or extra preparation; otherwise award 0 for unknown instructions or a verified mismatch. Count any removal dependency separately in kit assembly. Do not promise a duration.
scoring.goal_dimension_rule: quick_easy is represented by application_simplicity and the item cap, not awarded again inside ordered_goals. Cosmetic goals irrelevant to the family are inactive; natural_makeup activates requested coverage/finish preferences, and longer_wear activates wear preferences rather than earning duplicate points from the same trait.
scoring.ordered_goal_formula: One goal: goal1_match. Two goals: (2 * goal1_match + goal2_match) / 3; omit goals irrelevant to that slot before this calculation.
scoring.active_weight_rule: A missing/unknown user preference or inapplicable dimension removes that weight for every candidate in the same slot. Missing product metadata keeps the active weight and receives zero.
scoring.metadata_coverage_formula: 100 * sum(active_weight with known product evidence) / sum(active_weight)
scoring.goal_metadata_coverage: For two relevant goals, use (2 * known_goal1 + known_goal2) / 3 as the knownness factor for the goals weight, where known=1 and unknown=0. Other dimensions use known=1 or unknown=0. Display active dimensions and active-weight denominator with the score; coverage describes those dimensions only, not catalog completeness.
scoring.empty_preferences: If no active weights, fit score is null. Offer a visibly labeled basic option using eligibility and lower cost; do not fabricate personalization.
scoring.rounding: Rank using unrounded values; display scores to one decimal place.
scoring.soft_requirement_rule: Preferred but nonmandatory fragrance-free, vegan or similar claims do not change fit points. Use the count of distinct canonical user-selected preferences with verified exact-variant support as an explicit tie-break after fit, before cost. Unknown claims earn zero tie-break credit and remain labeled unknown. A mandatory version uses F03 instead.
scoring.tagging_rule: Match against reviewed structured product traits with evidence URLs, dates, and basis (brand fact or editorial inference). Do not infer efficacy, safety, or fragrance absence from a single ingredient. Product prose is not automatically a production tag.

kit_assembly.default_makeup_slots: User selects base, lip/cheek, eyes. Help-start-small proposes one lip OR cheek color slot, visibly editable. Base is opt-in and shade-gated.
kit_assembly.both: Union of confirmed skincare and makeup slots, deduplicated.
kit_assembly.owned_items: Kept slots incur zero purchase cost but count toward daily item cap. Replacements require an explicit request.
kit_assembly.optional_extras: Toner, essence, serum, eye product, additional color, and exfoliating/retinoid products are off by default. Add only when requested; introduce no automatic active-ingredient stack.
kit_assembly.budget_equation: New merchandise cents + verified shipping cents + verified tax cents <= total budget cents
kit_assembly.budget_validation: Budget and reserve must be nonnegative finite integer cents in the same currency; reserve cannot exceed budget. A missing budget yields an unpriced preview and no claim of a budget-compliant kit. Reject unsupported currency conversions until an explicit rate and timestamp are available.
kit_assembly.planning_equation: When shipping/tax are unknown: new merchandise cents <= total budget cents - user_confirmed_cost_reserve_cents; label planning_estimate. With no reserve, show merchandise-only estimate and no checkout-budget guarantee.
kit_assembly.cost_basis: Existing regular snapshot prices for the prototype; exact variant prices, currency, stock and seller-specific charges refreshed before a purchase-ready result.
selection_order: satisfy all confirmed required slots and item/dependency limits
maximize sum of within-slot fit scores for the same fixed set of slots
maximize total verified soft requirement matches
kit_assembly.unknown_score: A slot with no active preferences gives all eligible candidates equal zero optimization utility and uses cost tie-breaks; user-facing fit score stays null.
kit_assembly.infeasible: Return partial_planning_kit with missing-slot reasons, cheapest feasible required-slot cost if calculable, and explicit options to change scope/budget. For partial composition, follow the visible user-confirmed ordered slot priorities lexicographically: fulfill the highest-priority slot whenever feasible, then the next, within budget, dependency and item limits. For the same achievable slot set, apply score, soft preference, cost and stable-ID ordering. List every unfilled slot; never relax exclusions, exceed budget, or silently drop a requested slot.
kit_assembly.optional_selection: Requested optional additions are tried in the user's priority order after all required slots. Re-optimize within constraints. Defer any addition that fails budget, evidence or complexity rules.
kit_assembly.swap_rule: Re-run the full filters, dependency checks, whole-kit budget and item cap for every swap; do not use a category winner without checking the other selected items.
kit_assembly.compatibility_claim: No claim that a combination is guaranteed compatible; product application guidance and removal dependencies must be separately verified.

recommendation_record.reason_template: You chose {answer}. This product has {supported_trait}. It contributes {points} fit points and adds {cost} to your kit.
recommendation_record.selection_template: This option fills {slot} while keeping the planned kit subtotal at {subtotal}. {remaining_checks}.
recommendation_record.language_model_policy: An optional LLM may paraphrase structured reasons and verified facts. It may not select new product IDs, alter scores, invent prices/shades/ingredients, claim diagnosis or clear missing evidence.

catalog_gaps: Complete current INCI per exact formula and shade for ingredient exclusion clearance
Reviewed structured traits for finish, coverage, texture, application, removal, requirements and cosmetic goals
Foundation/cushion/concealer SKUs, supported shade ranges and independently checked mappings
Current exact-variant stock, price, retailer charges, shipping and tax
acceptance_cases: No selfie and identical confirmed answers produce identical skincare rankings.
Dry-feeling answer plus shiny selfie does not change reported skin feel.
Unconfirmed selfie estimates add no points or eligible exact base shade.
The same user-selected goal supplied twice is scored once; no hydration goal is inferred from pixels.
An avoided ingredient listed only in evidence_notes still excludes a product.
An avoided ingredient missing from key ingredients yields needs_verification, not clearance.
Strict fragrance-free excludes a product with verified fragrance; unknown requirements remain pending.
A skipped texture answer removes the texture weight for all candidates in that slot.
Unknown product texture earns zero texture points and lowers metadata coverage.
Keeping an owned cleanser removes its purchase cost and prevents a duplicate cleanser.
No supported base shade returns a visible missing slot and partial kit.
If the cheapest required kit exceeds budget, report infeasibility rather than exceeding it.
Swapping or adding a product rechecks total cost, required remover and item cap.
Planning estimates are never labeled purchase-ready without price, stock, shipping and tax checks.
All hard filters pass or are non-applicable yields eligible rather than pending.
Zero active preference weights yields a null fit score.
A score of 100 from one dimension shows that dimension and its denominator explicitly.
Equality at the exact cent budget boundary is permitted; one cent above fails.
A negative reserve or reserve above budget is rejected.

sources.supports: Simple cleansing, moisturizing and sun-protection routine; broad-spectrum SPF 30 or higher; sensitivity may involve stinging or burning.
Camera geometry and illumination affect recorded color in standardized skin-tone color swatches; approximate selfie shade policy is a design inference, not validated performance of this app.
